notes.title: Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage 1.05 patch note (April 07, 2025)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44846858/31e9a72f98a4bc8baf2fc24209a871f5aa83a0fc.jpg[/img]

Hello from the team at CFK.

Thank you for all of the love and attention you've paid to vertically scrolling manic shooter game Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage.

In order to create a richer, smoother gaming experience for players, patch ver. 1.05 will be released today (4/07) with the following changes:

● The bug where some achievements were not unlocking has been fixed.

We hope you'll experience this smoother version of Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage for yourself, and thank you to all of the people who have played Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage and visited our community page.

As always, thank you for your continued support as we at CFK strive to be the very best publisher we can be.

Thank you.

notes.title: Shikhondo(食魂徒) - Soul Eater to be unlisted
notes.content:
Hello!

Let us start by thanking all of the gamers who have played and recalled Shikhondo(食魂徒) - Soul Eater for these past 7 years.

On April 18th, 2024 (Thursday), we will be releasing Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage, a new version of this game we've been working on alongside publisher CFK.

Players with Shikhondo(食魂徒) - Soul Eater in their libraries will still be able to play the game, and as a special thanks to those of you who look back on the original, those players will also be able to receive a special discount on Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage.

[b]◎ New features of Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage[/b]
- Character voices added
- New stage added
- Resolution / UI / Effect remaster
- New Dual mode added / Customize mode reworked

For more detailed information, visit:

[b]◎ Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage Steam store page[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2712480/Shikhondo_Youkai_Rampage/

Alongside this release, we are still hard at work on the sequel to this game, Shikohondo: Blue Pieta.
We hope you'll continue to closely follow the Shikhondo series.

Many thanks,
The team at Deerfarm

tags.feature: - New Dual mode added / Customize mode reworked
